nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, declared in Ownable and written by the constructor, renounceOwnership and _transferOwnership.
mapping(bytes32 => bytes32) companyMap in BlockchainId, mapping company identifiers to merkle roots; written by create/update/delete functions.
Ownable constructor that initializes the owner state variable from the deploying account.
onlyOwner modifier implementing the access control gate: require(msg.sender == owner).
Public onlyOwner function that emits OwnershipRenounced and resets owner to address(0).
Public onlyOwner function that forwards ownership transfer to the internal _transferOwnership routine.
Internal routine that validates the new owner is non-zero, emits OwnershipTransferred and assigns owner.
Public onlyOwner function that stores a merkle root for a company id in companyMap and emits NewCompany.
Public onlyOwner batch function that validates equal array lengths and loops calling _createCompany.
Public view function returning the merkle root stored in companyMap for a given company id.
Public onlyOwner function that overwrites the merkle root of a company id and emits ChangeCompany.
Public onlyOwner batch function that validates equal array lengths and loops calling _updateCompany.
Public onlyOwner function that deletes the companyMap entry for a company id and emits DeleteCompany.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for ownership initialization and for the onlyOwner authorization check.
owner = msg.sender in the Ownable constructor: unrestrained privilege initialization from an untrusted caller address.
require(msg.sender == owner) inside onlyOwner: the sole access-control guard protecting all privileged state mutations.
owner = address(0) in renounceOwnership: irreversible write to the privileged owner state variable.
owner = _newOwner in _transferOwnership: privileged reassignment of the owner state variable to a caller-supplied address.
companyMap[companyId] = merkleRoot in _createCompany: privileged storage write to the company mapping.
companyMap[companyId] = merkleRoot in _updateCompany: privileged overwrite of an existing company mapping entry.
delete companyMap[companyId] in _deleteCompany: privileged deletion of a company mapping entry.
Unbounded for loop in _createCompanies iterating companyIds.length while performing storage writes.
Unbounded for loop in _updateCompanies iterating companyIds.length while performing storage writes.

edges.reason: The untrusted caller address msg.sender is written directly into the owner state variable, initializing contract privileges.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the require statement that enforces the onlyOwner access control check.
Constructor assignment writes the owner state variable from an untrusted address.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into the owner state variable.
_transferOwnership assigns the caller-supplied new owner into the owner state variable.
The _newOwner parameter flows into the privileged owner reassignment operation.
The _newOwner parameter of transferOwnership is consumed by that function.
The companyId parameter is consumed by _createCompany.
The merkleRoot parameter is consumed by _createCompany.
companyId is used as the storage key in the companyMap write.

The privileged write modifies the companyMap state variable.
The companyIds array parameter drives the batch creation loop.

The companyId parameter is consumed by _updateCompany.
The merkleRoot parameter is consumed by _updateCompany.

The companyId parameter is used to read the companyMap entry in getCompany.
The companyId parameter is consumed by _deleteCompany.

onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership, restricting it to the owner.
